description: linear 6->5 (bias trainable: false), relu, linear 5->3, in training mode. Batch 4, seed 11, step 0.
reference: the graph as PyTorch functional ops in f64 on the f32 weights and input, rounded once to f32; gradients: torch.autograd.grad((y * grad_y).sum(), trainable params)
notes: Dropout multiplies by x * (mask / (1 - p)) with the Polypous keep mask of `training.seed`, `training.step` and the node path (graph-ir.md §3.1.12, polyrng.dropout_mask), stored under `masks`. batch_norm runs F.batch_norm(..., training=True); `running_stats` are its updated running statistics. Gradients are listed for every trainable param (trainable: true and not a running statistic) in declaration order; the other params get none.
